MESSAGE: Golden Freddy: He will occasionally appear in you office. Pull up your monitor quickly to cause to disappear.
Withered Freddy: He will appear in your office poised to attack! Throw on your Freddy mask to make him leave again.
Endo 01: He stands in the Parts and Service room and walks down the left corridor, close the left door when he's in the corridor.
Withered Foxy: When he moves, you must use your flashlight to reset him.
Shadow Freddy: When it appears on your monitor, close it or change cameras so it won't attack you.
Endo 02: He will attack through the ventilation, making noises and flashing lights before attacking. Close the right vent door to lock it.
Phantom Chica: When she appears on your monitor, quickly close it ot change the cam to avoid his jumpscare.
Phantom Foxy: When he shows up at your office, light the flashlight on him to avoid his jumpscare.
Phantom Puppet: He appears at the right door, turn his flashlight on him or he will block his view, mask, flashlight and monitor for a few seconds.
Nightmare Foxy: When you hear his run, close the right door, but if he can come in, turn on the flashlight for him to leave.
Jack-o-Bonnie: When the office gets hot, it appears on both doors at the same time, do not let the temperature rise above 90 degrees to avoid its attack.

Adventure Freddy: He make his way toward the vent opening embedded in the wall in front of you. When he is poised to attack you will see his face looking down at you. Close the vent door to send him away.

MESSAGE: Adventure Bonnie: He sits in the Parts and Services room playing FNaF World on his big screen TV. If he is fighting in the game, click and change the button above to "Fight", if he is not fighting, change the button to "Move".
Adventure Chica: When her cupcake appears on the table, click it so she won't attack you.
Adventure Foxy: He will gradually leave Pirate's Cove if you don't check on him regularly. If it comes out, close the left door to block it.
Adventure Fredbear: When you see him in your office, click on him quickly, otherwise he will give you a jumpscare.
Scott: He stays in the office as a 2D sprite form and will try to transform intro his 3D form to attack you, click him to get him back to his 2D form.

Funtime Freddy: He goes to both corridors. Look in the cameras and close the appropriate door, if he is on the left he will send BonBon to attack you, but if he is on the right, he will attack you himself.
BidyBad: He climbs in the vents. Listen for his voice, then shut the door before he gets through, and wait he knock on the door.

Electrobad: He climbs in the vents. Listen for his shock noise, then shut the door before he gets through, and wait he knock on the door. but if he comes in, he'll be draining the office power until the night is over.

White Rabbit:  He appears randomly on your desk, turn the flashlight on him to send him away.

Prize King: He appears and adds a secret character to your night.
Spring Bonnie: He starts the night at his office, let his spring locks tight or he will finish the game with a jumpscare.
